outcome_blind: sequences and metadata only; no assay score file opened

clusterer.reason: MMseqs2 not installed locally; this is the aligner already used for construct mapping in route_a_common.py
clusterer.mode_deviation: route_a_common uses global with free end gaps for construct mapping; local is used here because the question is shared-domain homology between different proteins, and local is more sensitive, which over-groups rather than under-groups
clusterer.coverage_definition: min(aligned/len_a, aligned/len_b), i.e. MMseqs2 --cov-mode 0: the alignment must cover the threshold fraction of BOTH sequences

confirmation_membrane_is_forced_not_draw: exactly 6 eligible proteins have substantial flank<=60 coverage and 6 is the minimum for a decisive exact sign-flip p, so all 6 are reserved deterministically; there is nothing to draw from
resolution_rule: any group containing a confirmation protein has its entire membership barred from every fitted stage
